points.description: States that the parameters K (storage/travel-time constant) and x (weighting factor) are assumed constant, i.e. not changing with time (they depend only on the channel reach).
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of K or x is said to be constant, or constancy is stated vaguely.

points.description: States that the storage-discharge relationship is linear (S = K[xI + (1-x)O], with exponent m = 1), i.e. outflow relates linearly to inflow.
points.partial_credit: Half if linearity is mentioned without the storage/inflow-outflow relation or m = 1.

points.description: States that the method applies to channel routing (river reach) only, with x as a weighting factor between inflow and outflow in storage.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two (channel routing only, or x as weighting factor) is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need all three ideas: K and x constant in time, linear storage-discharge relation (m = 1), and applicability to channel routing with x as a weighting factor. Give part marks for a half-stated or vague idea; give none for unrelated or wrong statements. Round the total to the nearest half mark, so two clearly correct ideas give 1 to 1.5 and all three give 2. Do not penalise the model answer's "x = 1" wording if the student gives the correct role of x.
